s1_hook: If you run tours with more than a couple of vans, you know the five p.m. job. Who's driving tomorrow, and has everyone been told their pickup time. This is DayRunner. It does that job.
s2_decide: It pulls tomorrow's bookings, allocates vans and drivers inside the work-time rules, and gives you the three things that need a decision. You pick, it moves on. Then it drafts every pickup message in your voice. Nothing sends until you approve.
s3_cta: Tomorrow's day, decided by five p.m. I'm running three paid pilots in New Zealand this spring. Reply, and I'll set your bookings up myself.
